pairs: In die illa cantabitur canticum istud in terra Juda:
In that day, this canticle will be sung in the land of Judah.
Within it will be set the city of our strength:
salvator ponetur in ea murus et antemurale.
Zion, a savior, a wall with a bulwark.
et ingrediatur gens justa, custodiens veritatem.
and let the just people who guard the truth enter.
The old error has gone away.
for we have hoped in you.
Sperastis in Domino in sæculis æternis;
You have trusted in the Lord for all eternity,
in Domino Deo forti in perpetuum.
in the Lord God almighty forever.
For he will bend down those living in the heights.
He will bring low the lofty city.
He will lower it, even to the ground.
He will tear it down, even to the dust.
The foot will tread it down:
The path of the just is upright;
the difficult path of the just is right to walk in.
And in the path of your judgments,
nomen tuum et memoriale tuum in desiderio animæ.
Your name and your remembrance are the desire of the soul.
Anima mea desideravit te in nocte,
My soul has desired you in the night.
sed et spiritu meo in præcordiis meis de mane vigilabo ad te.
But I will also watch for you with my spirit, in my inmost heart, from the morning.
Cum feceris judicia tua in terra,
When you accomplish your judgments upon the earth,
the inhabitants of the world will learn justice.
Misereamur impio, et non discet justitiam;
Let us take pity on the impious one, but he will not learn justice.
In the land of the holy ones, he has done iniquity,
and so he will not see the glory of the Lord.
and let them not see it.
And may fire devour your enemies.
omnia enim opera nostra operatus es nobis.
For all our works have been wrought for us by you.
other lords have possessed us apart from you,
tantum in te recordemur nominis tui.
but in you alone let us remember your name.
let not the giants rise up again.
you have visited and destroyed them,
and you have perished all remembrance of them.
You have been lenient to the people,
You have removed all the limits of the earth.
Lord, they have sought you in anguish.
in tribulatione murmuris doctrina tua eis.
Your doctrine was with them, amid the tribulation of murmuring.
Sicut quæ concipit, cum appropinquaverit ad partum,
Like a woman who has conceived and is approaching the time for delivery,
who, in anguish, cries out in her pains,
sic facti sumus a facie tua,
so have we become before your face,
and it is as if we were in labor,
but we have given birth to wind.
We have not brought forth salvation on the earth.
For this reason, the inhabitants of the earth have not fallen.
My slain will rise again. Be awakened,
and give praise, you who live in the dust!
For your dew is the dew of the light,
quia ros lucis ros tuus, et terram gigantum detrahes in ruinam.
and you shall be dragged down to the land of the giants, to ruination.
Conceal yourselves for a very brief time,
until the indignation has passed over you.
Ecce enim Dominus egredietur de loco suo,
For behold, the Lord will go forth from his place,
ut visitet iniquitatem habitatoris terræ contra eum;
so that he may visit the iniquity of each inhabitant of the earth against him.
And the earth will reveal its blood,
et non operiet ultra interfectos suos.
and it will no longer cover its slain.
